taṃniddesa.p: [Ta+niddesa] (ti) CL=7 (1) (A) It is worthy of reference by that object or issue.(B) One who is referred to by that object or issue.  (2) (A) It expressed that object or issue by detail and elaborate version. (B) It is cause of expression of that object or status by detail and elaborate version.
a: တံနိဒ္ဒေသ(တိ)

B:
taṃniddesa： taṃniddesa（ti）
တံနိဒေ္ဒသ（တိ）
[ta+niddesa]
[တ+နိဒေ္ဒသ]

taṃninna.p: [Ta+ninna] (ti) CL=7 (A) It inclines to that object or issue. (B) One who has the mind which inclines in that status or issue.

B:
taṃninna： taṃninna（ti）
တံနိန္န（တိ）
[ta+ninna]
